bruiser_adrenaline_surge.upgrade_description: On Kill: HEAL 1 and gain SHIELD 2.

bruiser_belly_flop.upgrade_description: Landing applies PUSH 1 to all adjacent enemies.

bruiser_blood_boil.upgrade_description: Spend 10 HP to gain STR +5 instead.

bruiser_breaching_dash.upgrade_description: Your next attack this turn gains PIERCE.

bruiser_charge_strike.upgrade_description: Gain GHOST during MOVE. Gain ATK +2 if passing through terrain.

bruiser_cleave.upgrade_description: Apply BLEED X (where X = your WPN) to all targets.

bruiser_concussion_blow.upgrade_description: Enemy collision applies STAGGER to both units.

bruiser_crimson_whirlwind.upgrade_description: HEAL 1 for every target successfully hit.

bruiser_guttural_roar.upgrade_description: PUSH 1 all items/coins/scrap. Item collision: ATK 1.

bruiser_headbutt.upgrade_description: Deal bonus damage equal to 10% of your Max HP.

bruiser_push_through.upgrade_description: Cost reduced to 1 MOV. Pushing unit grants +1 STR for next attack.

bruiser_suplex.upgrade_description: Gain ATK +1 for every 10 Current HP you possess.

adrenaline_junkie.description: Gain MOVE +1 and STR +1 per 10% missing HP.
adrenaline_junkie.upgraded_description: [+] Also gain +1 DEF for every 20% missing HP.

battering_ram.upgraded_description: [+] Pushed enemies hitting walls suffer STAGGER.

blood_for_blood.description: If damaged last turn, attacks apply BLEED X (X = WPN).

cellular_regeneration.description: HEAL 1 if adjacent to 1+ enemies at turn start.
cellular_regeneration.upgraded_description: [+] Also gain +1 STR if adjacent to 2+ enemies.

colossal_mass.description: Gain +1 STR for every 15 Max HP.
colossal_mass.upgraded_description: [+] Gain +1 STR for every 10 Max HP instead.

crowd_breaker.description: +1 STR per adjacent enemy. Splash damage ATK 1.

juggernaut.description: Moving over traps destroys them for 0 damage.

last_stand.description: When HP < 25%, gain +2 STR and +2 DEF.

momentum_of_titan.description: PUSH collision adds damage = 10% Max HP.

overwhelming_bulk.description: If Current HP > target Max HP, attacks gain PIERCE.

scar_tissue.description: Reduce physical damage by 1 per 20 Max HP or missing HP.

thrill_of_pain.description: Damage taken adds ATK +2 and PUSH 1 to NEXT attack.

unstoppable_force.description: Immune to STAGGER/ROOT. Resisting grants SHIELD 1.

knight_chain_hook.upgrade_description: Target suffers VULNERABLE if pulled adjacent.

knight_shield_bash.upgrade_description: Apply STAGGER if collides with wall/enemy.

knight_swap.upgrade_description: Gain +2 DEF and SHIELD 2 for the rest of the turn.

collision_retaliator.description: Enemy collision suffers ATK 2. Knight takes 0 collision damage.

concussive_shatter.description: Enemy collision suffers extra damage equal to 50% of your DEF, and target loses -1 DEF.

intercept_tactics.description: Using a redirect skill grants +2 DEF.

kinetic_armor.description: Incoming damage reduced by flat 1 if SHIELD active.

kinetic_converter.description: When hit, gain STR +1 and MOVE +1 for next turn.

kinetic_momentum.description: Causing an enemy to suffer collision damage grants SHIELD equal to your STR + DEF for 1 turn.
kinetic_momentum.upgraded_description: [+] Also refunds 1 MOV point on your first collision each turn.

kinetic_redirection.description: Mitigating damage adds +1 STR to next attack (Stacks to +3).

living_barricade.description: Allies behind are immune to ranged attacks.

rallying_presence.description: Allies starting turn adjacent gain +1 MOV.

shield_wall.description: Adjacent allies gain +1 DEF and PULL immunity.

stand_ground.description: Immune to PUSH/PULL. Enemy attempts trigger COUNTER ATTACK 1.

thorny_carapace.description: Melee hit reflects 50% damage (rounded down) & PUSH 1.
